# המתכונים שלנו (Our Recipes)

> A family recipe collection in Hebrew: ~200 parsed recipes with structured
> ingredients, instructions, categories, prep/cook times and difficulty,
> originally curated in a family Telegram channel.

The web app at https://recipes.nehoraihadad.com requires a login (Telegram or
guest). AI agents should use the MCP server instead of scraping pages.

## MCP server (for AI agents)

- Endpoint: https://recipes.nehoraihadad.com/api/mcp
- Transport: Streamable HTTP (MCP spec 2025-03-26 and later)
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <shared key>` — the key is distributed
  privately by the site owner to family members; there is no public signup.
- Access is read-only. Tools:
  - `search_recipes` — free text / categories / difficulty / max total time
  - `get_recipe_details` — ingredients + instructions preview by recipe id
  - `list_categories` — all categories with recipe counts

Human-readable setup instructions (Hebrew): https://recipes.nehoraihadad.com/ai

## Notes

- All recipe content is in Hebrew (RTL).
- Difficulty values: קל, בינוני, מורכב.
- Categories are free-form Hebrew tags (e.g. עיקריות, קינוחים, צמחוני).
